title: Github Metric3 Rolling 7-Day Value Average
dataSources: GitHub repositories (`github:repo`), commits (`github:commit`), issues (`github:issue`), and releases (`github:release`).
app: GitHub repository metadata, commit activity feeds, issue trackers, and release publish logs forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=github:metric3 value=*
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(value) as daily_avg by _time
| streamstats window=7 avg(daily_avg) as rolling_7d
| sort _time
description: Tracks a seven-day rolling average of daily value for github metric3 (3) data.
value: Rolling averages highlight gradual drift without overreacting to one-off days.
implementation: Compute daily average `value` then a seven-day rolling mean for github metric3 (3) events.
visualization: Line chart of daily and rolling average value.
grandmaExplanation: It charts the smoothed week-long trend in your value from github metric3 (3).
